item.title: No. 8 Kansas rolls past Oklahoma State, 81-69
item.description: Freshman Darryn Peterson scored 20 of his 23 points in the first half, while freshman Bryson Tiller notched a double-double with 10 points and 11 rebounds, sparking No. 8 Kansas to an 81-69 win over Oklahoma State on Wednesday night.

item.title: One killed in motorcycle crash on Kansas Turnpike in Wichita
item.description: It happened on the northbound Kansas Turnpike near Harry Street and Rock Road.

item.title: Construction begins on new police station in West Wichita
item.description: The station will be located on the northeast corner of Wichita Northwest High School.

item.title: Storm Track 3 Forecast: Fire danger continues, shifting south Thursday
item.description: Chief Meteorologist Lisa Teachman says the fire threat will shift to the south on Thursday as a cold front crashes through Kansas. Two separate systems may also bring a small amount of moisture to the region by the weekend.

item.title: Resources avalible to Kansas ranchers, residents impacted by wildfires
item.description: Wildfires raged across southwest Kansas on Tuesday and Wednesday, burning almost 283,000 acres of land and killing hundreds of cattle.

item.title: Ranger Road Fire: Wildfire leaves widespread damage in Kansas, kills hundreds of cattle
item.description: The Ranger Road Fire started Tuesday in Beaver County, Oklahoma, and burned into Kansas. Crews from across the state continue working to contain it.

item.title: Kansas organizations collect donations to support firefighters, wildfire evacuees
item.description: Pratt County Emergency Management put the word out on social media Wednesday afternoon that it was collecting beverages to donate to nearby counties.

item.title: Family loses generations-old farm in southern Kansas wildfire
item.description: In the hundreds of thousands of acres that have burned in southern Kansas, people have lost pasture and cropland, cattle, and in some cases even their homes.

item.title: LIVE BLOG: Wildfires impact Kansas and Oklahoma
item.description: KSN News is monitoring the latest conditions on high winds and the extreme fire danger in Kansas.

item.title: President Trump nominates three Kansans to the federal bench
